Package com.ibm.websphere.monitor.jmx

Class StatisticsMeter

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.ibm.websphere.monitor.jmx.Meter
      • com.ibm.websphere.monitor.jmx.StatisticsMeter
  • public class StatisticsMeter
extends Meter
